name_zh: 工业4.0/德国/互联工厂/数字孪生/平台工业/标准制定/出口
description_zh: 德国工业 4.0 (Industrie 4.0) 2011年汉诺威博览会提出，互联工厂/数字孪生/平台工业/标准制定四大支柱，西门子/博世/大众/巴斯夫/ SAP 引领数字化制造，互操作性标准 (RAMI 4.0/ OPC UA) 确立全球话语权，出口导向模式输出德国制造标准至全球，目标实现批量定制/柔性制造/预测性维护。
description_en: German Industry 4.0 proposed 2011 Hannover Messe, connected factory/digital twin/platform industry/standard setting four pillars, Siemens/Bosch/VW/BASF/SAP leading digital manufacturing, interoperability standards (RAMI 4.0/OPC UA) establishing global discourse power, export-oriented model exporting German manufacturing standards globally, targeting mass customization/flexible manufacturing/predictive maintenance.
reason_zh: 德国工业 4.0 代表制造强国如何通过标准制定锁定全球价值链高地，展示了平台工业如何重构制造业组织形态，其标准霸权 (OPC UA/RAMI 4.0) 为全球数字化制造确立了德国主导的规则体系。
reason_en: German Industry 4.0 represents how manufacturing power locks global value chain high ground through standard setting, demonstrating how platform industry reconstructs manufacturing organizational form, its standard hegemony (OPC UA/RAMI 4.0) establishing German-dominated rule system for global digital manufacturing.

评估平台工业/互操作性/标准霸权/出口导向/中德/美德合作
总结互联工厂/数字孪生/平台工业/标准霸权/出口导向五重遗产

Analyze RAMI 4.0 reference architecture/OPC UA interoperability/digital twin standard

Summarize connected factory/digital twin/platform industry/standard hegemony/export orientation quintuple legacy
expected_zh: 掌握标准制定如何锁定全球价值链话语权，理解平台工业如何重构制造业生产关系，评估德国工业 4.0 标准体系对全球数字化制造的统治性影响。
expected_en: Master how standard setting locks global value chain discourse power, grasp how platform industry reconstructs manufacturing production relations, evaluate German Industry 4.0 standard system dominating influence on global digital manufacturing.

case_en: 2011 Hannover proposed; 2013 RAMI 4.0; 2015 platform industry; 2020 digital twin. Connected factory/digital twin/platform industry/standard hegemony/export orientation paradigm endures.
